pp2.7:1.1: kathañca puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti
pp2.7:1.2: idhekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi
pp2.7:1.3: evaṃ puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti.
pp2.7:2.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhuottappakusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhuviriyakusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhupaññākusalesu dhammesūti
pp2.7:2.3: tassa sā saddhā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva tassa sā hiri neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva tassa taṃ ottappaṃ neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva tassa taṃ viriyaṃ neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva tassa sā paññā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva
pp2.7:3.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu … sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu sāhuottappakusalesu dhammesu sāhuviriyakusalesu dhammesu sāhupaññākusalesu dhammesūti
pp2.7:3.3: tassa sā saddhā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti tassa sā hiri neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti tassa taṃ ottappaṃ neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitaṃ hoti tassa taṃ viriyaṃ neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitaṃ hoti tassa sā paññā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti
pp2.7:4.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu … sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu sāhuottappakusalesu dhammesu sāhuviriyakusalesu dhammesu sāhupaññākusalesu dhammesūti
pp2.7:4.3: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano
pp2.7:5.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu … sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu sāhuottappakusalesu dhammesu sāhuviriyakusalesu dhammesu sāhupaññākusalesu dhammesūti
pp2.7:5.3: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantakaro hoti
pp2.7:6.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu sāhuottappakusalesu dhammesu sāhuviriyakusalesu dhammesu sāhupaññākusalesu dhammesūti
pp2.7:6.3: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
pp2.7:7.1: kathañca puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo
pp2.7:7.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhuottappakusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu ummujjati sāhupaññākusalesu dhammesūti
pp2.7:7.3: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
pp2.7:7.4: evaṃ puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
pp2.7:8.2: idhekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
pp2.7:14.2: yassa puggalassa sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa saddhindriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti saddhāvāhiṃ saddhāpubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti
pp2.7:14.4: sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo saddhānusārī. phale ṭhito saddhāvimuttoti.
